title: decisions log: first-class --supersedes edge + prose-supersession guard
action: Give `decisions log` a --supersedes:arr flag (full id or unique short8, validated against active decide/supersede events) that writes the decide event with a `supersedes` field; extend active_decisions() to exclude ids named by a `supersedes` field on ANY event type (string or array), not only type=='supersede'. Guard: decision text matching supersession prose (supersede(s|d)/replaces/overrides/'no longer applies'/'instead of the previous') with no --supersedes and not via `decisions supersede` gets a typed refusal naming both remedies. Registry payload is generated — change flows through the `bee dev` regen chain, never hand-edited.
verify: cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml — new cases: log with --supersedes drops target from active; prose-supersession without edge refused with remedy; short8 resolution; ambiguous/unknown target refused

trace.outcome: decisions log gained --supersedes (active-set resolution, full id or unique short8) plus a prose-supersession guard that refuses inline supersede/replaces/overrides/no-longer-applies/instead-of-the-previous text without the edge; active_decisions() now honors any event's supersedes field, string or array
trace.inline_reason: cold-pickup generation worker dispatched straight to this pre-claimed cell in the feature worktree, per the dispatch contract; state worker add refuses inside a granted feature worktree (control-plane verb, main-checkout only), so no registration step was reachable from here
